mechanics.claim: Daisy! can be recast any number of times while Daisy is alive, and only the initial cast counts as an ability activation for on-cast effects.
mechanics.quote: Only the initial cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}}

mechanics.claim: The recast cannot be interrupted and can be used while affected by cast-inhibiting crowd control.
mechanics.quote: The recast of Daisy! can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}

mechanics.claim: Cooldown starts on cast (the initial summon), not on Daisy's death or recast.
Whenever Daisy attacks the same champion three times in a row, she sends a shockwave that knocks up enemies hit in a line - a separate damage instance from her basic attacks.
mechanics.quote: Whenever {{ui|Daisy}} attacks the same champion three times in a row, she will send a shockwave that {{tip|airborne|knocks up}} enemies hit within a line

mechanics.claim: Daisy is untargetable until she lands after the initial cast.
mechanics.quote: ''Daisy'', when the ability is initially cast, is {{tip|untargetable}} until she lands
